socfpga_fcs.h

Flexible Cryptographic Subsystem (FCS) driver. It talks to the Secure Device Manager mailbox for AES, ECDSA, digests, and keys.

Constants
Buffer and key sizes

Sizes for crypto buffers and keys, in bytes.

FCS_RNG_MAX_SIZE

Most random bytes one call may ask for.

FCS_UUID_SIZE

Session UUID length.

FCS_MAX_KEY_SIZE

Largest key import and create will accept.

FCS_SDOS_MIN_INPUT

Smallest SDOS input.

FCS_SDOS_MAX_INPUT

Largest SDOS input.

FCS_SDOS_ENC_MAX_RESP

Largest SDOS encrypt response. Passed to the mailbox as the response size.

FCS_SDOS_DEC_MAX_RESP

Largest SDOS decrypt response. Passed to the mailbox as the response size.

FCS_ATTEST_CERT_MAX_SIZE

Largest attestation certificate the driver prepares a buffer for.

FCS_MCTP_MAX_SIZE

Largest MCTP response the driver prepares a buffer for.

FCS_PROV_DATA_MAX_SIZE

Largest provisioning blob the driver prepares a buffer for.

FCS_DEV_IDENTITY_RESP_SIZE

Device-identity buffer size.

FCS_ECDH_MAX_RESP

Largest ECDH response. The driver uses it as the shared-secret buffer size.

SDOS configuration

Values for the Secure Data Object Service (SDOS).

FCS_SDOS_MAGIC_NUMBER

Magic number for an SDOS header.

FCS_SDOS_HEADER_PADDING

Padding word for an SDOS header.

FCS_SDOS_ENCRYPT_MODE

Mailbox mode for SDOS encrypt (1).

FCS_SDOS_DECRYPT_MODE

Mailbox mode for SDOS decrypt (0).

Digest and hashing modes

Digest mode and size codes. In SHA-2 mode the driver clears the key id.

FCS_DIGEST_OPMODE_SHA2

SHA-2 hash mode (1).

FCS_DIGEST_OPMODE_HMAC

HMAC mode (2).

FCS_DIGEST_SIZE_256

256-bit digest size code (0).

FCS_DIGEST_SIZE_384

384-bit digest size code (1).

FCS_DIGEST_SIZE_512

512-bit digest size code (2).

AES configuration

AES mode, GCM tag, and IV-source codes. The driver rejects a block mode outside this list, a tag code above the 128-bit code, and an IV source above the internal-base code. GCM-GHASH forces the crypt mode to 0.

FCS_AES_ENCRYPT_MODE

Encrypt (0).

FCS_AES_DECRYPT_MODE

Decrypt (1).

FCS_AES_ECB

ECB block mode (0).

FCS_AES_CBC

CBC block mode (1).

FCS_AES_CTR

CTR block mode (2).

FCS_AES_GCM

GCM block mode (3).

FCS_AES_GCM_GHASH

GCM-GHASH block mode (4).

FCS_AES_TAG_32

32-bit GCM tag code (0).

FCS_AES_TAG_64

64-bit GCM tag code (1).

FCS_AES_TAG_96

96-bit GCM tag code (2).

FCS_AES_TAG_128

128-bit GCM tag code (3).

FCS_GCM_TAG_SIZE

GCM tag length, in bytes (16). Added to a GCM buffer.

FCS_IV_EXTERNAL

IV-source code 0 (external).

FCS_IV_INTERNAL_DRNG

IV-source code 1 (internal DRNG).

FCS_IV_INTERNAL_BASE

IV-source code 2 (internal base).

ECC and key exchange configuration

Curve, HKDF, and size values. The driver rejects an ECC algorithm that is not one of the four curve codes.

FCS_ECC_NISTP_256

NIST P-256 curve code (1).

FCS_ECC_NISTP_384

NIST P-384 curve code (2).

FCS_ECC_BRAINPOOL_256

Brainpool 256-bit curve code (3).

FCS_ECC_BRAINPOOL_384

Brainpool 384-bit curve code (4).

FCS_EXTRACT_AND_EXPAND

HKDF step code for extract and expand (0).

FCS_EXPAND

HKDF step code for expand (1).

FCS_EXPAND_GCM

HKDF step code 2 (expand with GCM).

FCS_HKDF_256

HKDF MAC-mode code for 256 bits (0).

FCS_HKDF_384

HKDF MAC-mode code for 384 bits (1).

FCS_HKDF_512

HKDF MAC-mode code for 512 bits (2).

FCS_SHARED_SEC_SIZE

Shared-secret size, in bytes (48).

FCS_MAX_SIG_SIZE

Largest signature, in bytes (96).

FCS_MAX_PUBKEY_SIZE

Largest public key, in bytes (96).

fcs_sdos_crypt_header
struct
fcs_sdos_crypt_header

Defines the header structure for Secure Data Object Service (SDOS) cryptographic payloads.

fcs_init
int fcs_init(
void
)

Initializes the FCS driver layer and the underlying SIP_SVC mailbox interface.

Returns

0 on success; -EIO if the FCS service cannot be contacted, or -EINVAL if internal driver memory allocation fails.

fcs_deinit
int fcs_deinit(
void
)

Shuts down the FCS driver, clearing internal buffers and relinquishing mailbox resources.

Returns

0 on success; -EIO if the FCS service is unresponsive.

run_fcs_open_service_session
int run_fcs_open_service_session(
char 
*
uuid
)

Initiates a cryptographic session with the SDM. This binds the host's mailbox client to a unique session identifier (UUID).

Parameters
uuid
char*

Pointer to a buffer where the generated 16-byte session UUID will be stored.

Returns

0 on success; -EIO or -EINVAL if the session request is rejected.

*
uuid
)

Tears down a cryptographic session and releases the associated mailbox client resources.

Parameters
uuid
char*

The UUID of the session to terminate.

Returns

0 on success; -EIO if the session closure fails.
